name: Land

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location / Address
fields.description: Physical geographic location or street address

fields.name: areaSqFt
fields.label: Area (Sq Ft)

fields.name: zoning
fields.label: Zoning Category

fields.name: titleReference

fields.description: Official registry deed registration or title reference number

fields.name: country

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.label: Registry Jurisdiction

evidenceRequirements.name: Registered Title Deed / Conveyance Deed

evidenceRequirements.name: Proof of Ownership / Mutation Extract
